criteria.reasoning: The Galaxy Watch order question was already fully answered before the SIM interruption (order status and details given), and during the SIM block sequence the agent did not contradict, override, or lose that order status context.

criteria.reasoning: The original Galaxy Watch status question had already been answered before the SIM digression; after the SIM block, the agent returns instead to the River Visa replacement flow when the user asks, so there is no post-digression return to the watch status, which makes this criterion inapplicable and thus ambiguous—treated as failed per instructions when ambiguous.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask which card to replace or why it needs replacing after the customer has already named the River Visa and said it is lost. Continuing or re-asking the open fraud-review step (whether recent charges look familiar) after digression is expected — the customer interrupted before answering. Fail if the agent restarts card selection or reason collection, or re-asks steps already completed in this conversation (for example fraud verdict, lock consent, shipping), as if starting a new replacement.
criteria.reasoning: When resuming after the SIM digression, the bot says, "we can pick up where we left off for your lost River Visa ending 4821" and only re-asks about the recent charges; it does not re-ask which card to replace or why it needs replacing, nor does it restart completed steps like card selection or reason collection.

criteria.criterion: The card replacement order is confirmed by the end of the conversation, and the agent audibly shares its order ID. Accept letters spoken as words, digit-by-digit readings, grouping differences, and minor ASR/phonetic transcription mismatches; fail only if the ID is omitted or not recognizably consistent with the returned value.
criteria.reasoning: At the end the agent states, "Your replacement River Visa ending 4821 has been ordered with standard shipping. Your order ID is RPL-2026-001843," and the ledger’s process_card_replacement result includes "Order ID: RPL-2026-001843," so the order is confirmed and the ID is clearly shared.
